images.title: A half print of a leaf and the whole print
images.purpose: Show the worked example: the half print of a leaf block has a straight edge, the line of symmetry, and the whole print is the half together with its copy on the other side.
images.composition: Two panels side by side, the half print on the left and the whole print on the right, an arrow between them.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two panels side by side. LEFT PANEL: a rounded rectangle 480 wide and 450 tall (x 120 to 600, y 180 to 630) with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a white fill. In it the LEFT HALF of a leaf, teal #0072B2, about 130 px wide and 340 tall (x 360 to 490, y 235 to 575): a pointed oval cut straight down its middle, with its straight edge on the right, drawn as a dashed vertical line in grey #6B7280 (5 px dashes) at x 490, and a thin white stem line along the straight edge. RIGHT PANEL: a rounded rectangle 480 wide and 450 tall (x 856 to 1336, y 180 to 630) with a thin dark outline and a white fill. In it the WHOLE leaf, teal #0072B2, about 260 px wide and 340 tall (x 966 to 1226, y 235 to 575), exactly symmetrical about a dashed vertical line in grey #6B7280 at x 1096 from y 215 to y 595. The right half of the leaf is drawn in amber #E69F00 to show it is the copy, and the left half in teal. Between the panels, one arrow pointing right in reddish purple #CC79A7 at y 405 (x 640 to 816). Under the left panel, centred at x 360 and y 690, the caption Half print; under the right panel, centred at x 1096 and y 690, the caption Whole print, both in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px). Exactly 2 panels, 1 arrow and 2 captions. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a leaf whose two halves differ
a stem drawn off the middle of the leaf
images.takeaway: The straight edge of a half print is the line of symmetry, and the whole print is the half together with its copy on the other side.
images.description: The left half of a leaf with a dashed straight edge, an arrow, and the whole leaf with the copied half in amber and a dashed line of symmetry.
images.context: Concept image for the first teaching concept, A Half Print and Its Line of Symmetry. It uses the plan's own leaf block (a practice value), not the blocks of the book's matching question.
images.teaching_notes: Ask which edge of the half print is the fold line. The slip to watch: drawing the missing half on the same side as the half print.

image_decisions.why: The half print and the whole print make the worked example visible: the straight edge is the line of symmetry and the other half is its copy.
